title: DcMotorEx: Velocity Control

hints.title: Getting a DcMotorEx from hardwareMap
hints.content: Use `DcMotorEx motor = hardwareMap.get(DcMotorEx.class, "motorName");` — note `DcMotorEx.class` instead of `DcMotor.class`. The hardware map returns the same physical motor, but as the extended interface.

hints.title: Required run mode
hints.content: You must set the mode to `RUN_USING_ENCODER` before calling `setVelocity()`. Without this, velocity control has no encoder feedback to work with.

hints.title: What setVelocity() does
hints.content: `setVelocity(500)` tells the REV Hub's internal PIDF to maintain exactly 500 encoder ticks per second regardless of battery level. This is more consistent than `setPower()` which varies with voltage.
